_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ngue udi Mwene {player_id}, ukala {num_rounds} mavu ya Lodi ya Ultimatum.
Ngue na ${pool} ku kamba muna mavu mayi kati ya ngue na Mwene {other_id}.

Mwene wakala:
  - Tala kamba: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Kamba yakatukwa → Ngue udi na $(pool - X), Mwene wakala udi na $X
  - Kamba yakatukwa → Wawili udi na $0
  - Exemplo: [Offer: $3]  ou  'Ngue ndi mona kamba yayi. [Offer: $5]'

Mwene wakalwa:
  - Sola kamba yayi na [Accept] ou [Reject]
  - Exemplo: 'Kamba yayi kudi mona. [Accept]'
            'Kamba yayi kudi mbi. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mwezi {round_number} ukina! ---
Ngweji {proposer_id} ndi ngweji wa kuleta, ngweji {responder_id} ndi ngweji wa kujibu.
round.accepted: Ngweji {responder_id} yamukinji! Mwezi {round_number} ukina: Ngweji {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, ngweji {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Ngweji 0: $ {total_0}, ngweji 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Ngweji {responder_id} yamukatiki ofele! Mwezi {round_number} ukina: Ngweji wote +$0. Jumla ikabaki: Ngweji 0: $ {total_0}, ngweji 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: O muthu ua mesena kusumba kima, u tena ku ki soneka mu mukanda [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Kimbila kya kuunga kikwama kuwa nambari nzuri.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O kitadi kia tokala kukala mu kaxi ka $0 ni ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ka ku bhana ujitu phala eie.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: O muthu ua tokala u soneka o mukanda iú, [Accept] mba [Reject] ia mbeji.

outcome.win: Ngweji {winner} ukina ushindi na $ {winner_total} jumla kinyume na ngweji {loser} wa $ {loser_total}.
outcome.draw: O jokala a zubha ni kitadi kia tenesa mu ${total}.
